page.overview:
What is Eitar's Village?

Eitar's Village is a location in Final Fantasy Legend III.

The first village Arthur comes across when he arrives in Pureland. Unfortunately, the village is infested with BlackCats and the villagers are all turned into stone except for Eitar. He mentions that he saw Fenrir take Faye to the North Maze, he also says that no Purelander can oppose the Masters. Arthur agrees to defeat Fenrir, and Eitar tells Arthur to take Catnip from the tree before heading after Fenrir.

After Fenrir's defeat, the villagers returns back to normal. Eitar also tells Arthur to go seek Buzi in Mt. Hasbid.
